mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku(sku_id, stock_quantity, price_at_sku, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{stockQuantity}, #{priceAtSku}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, s.price_at_sku AS priceAtSku, s.created_at AS createdAt, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(o.option_name, ':', o.option_value) ORDER BY o.option_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS optionSummary FROM sku s JOIN option_sku os ON os.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN options o ON o.option_id = os.option_id WHERE o.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.stock_quantity, s.price_at_sku, s.created_at ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT o.option_id AS optionId, o.product_id AS productId, o.option_name AS optionName, o.option_value AS optionValue FROM options o JOIN option_sku os ON os.option_id = o.option_id WHERE os.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY o.option_name, o.option_value
